data.one_liner: Fast Dart profanity and swear word filter with phone number detection for 80+ languages.
data.what_it_does: Filters offensive language and detects phone numbers in text using the Aho-Corasick algorithm. Supports character substitutions, custom word lists, and multiple masking strategies across 80+ languages.
use_when: You need to moderate user-generated text content like chat messages or comments
You want to detect phone numbers embedded in natural language or mixed formats
Performance on the UI thread is critical
avoid_when: You require complex contextual or semantic AI-based content moderation beyond dictionary lookups
strengths: High performance suitable for running on the UI thread
Supports 80+ languages and 55,000+ curated bad words
Detects various phone number formats including leet-speak and multipliers
weaknesses: Relies on keyword and pattern matching which can produce false positives or miss context-dependent slurs
